description: This file defines a Java interface 'LoanDelinquencyDomainService' which declares methods related to managing and retrieving delinquency and overdue data for loans within a financial application, specifically part of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyDomainService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods to handle delinquency and overdue data calculations for loans.

methods.name: getOverdueCollectionData
methods.description: Calculates overdue collection data for a given loan based on effective delinquency list.

methods.name: getLoanDelinquencyData
methods.description: Retrieves delinquency data for a given loan considering effective delinquency actions.
